description: FK to Calendar Date Dimension — ngày cuối quý của kỳ báo cáo BCDKT
FK to Securities Company Dimension (reuse QLKD) — CTCK niêm yết nối IDS qua mã chứng khoán (securities_company.securities_code = public_company.equity_ticker_symbol)
Tổng nợ phải trả của CTCK niêm yết tại quý báo cáo (BCDKT, row_desc 300 DN/BH – 400 TD, col_desc 1) — cùng cách BA dòng 339 Nhóm 21 (O_PTTT_32)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN securities_company ON securities_company.src_stm_code = 'SCMS_SC_FIRM_INFO' AND securities_company.securities_code IS NOT NULL → INNER JOIN public_company ON public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' AND public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = securities_company.securities_code → INNER JOIN pc_report_submission ON pc_report_submission.pc_id = public_company.pc_id AND pc_report_submission.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) IN ('HN','TH','ME','RI') AND pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter IN (1,2,3,4) AND pc_report_submission.submission_dt <= :etl_date [rn0 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id, pc_report_submission.rpt_year, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter ORDER BY CASE SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) WHEN 'HN' THEN 1 WHEN 'TH' THEN 2 WHEN 'ME' THEN 3 WHEN 'RI' THEN 4 END, pc_report_submission.submission_dt DESC — chot DUNG 1 bao cao/ky truoc khi xep hang ky] WHERE rn0 = 1 [giữ MỌI quý đã công bố — không xếp hạng rn1; BI chọn quý gần nhất] INNER JOIN fr_value ON fr_value.pc_id = pc_report_submission.pc_id AND fr_value.rpt_year = pc_report_submission.rpt_year AND fr_value.rpt_quarter = pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter INNER JOIN fr_catalog ON fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id = fr_value.fr_catalog_id AND fr_catalog.financial_statement_tp_code = SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) AND fr_catalog.rpt_code LIKE 'BCDKT%' INNER JOIN fr_row_template ON fr_row_template.row_code = fr_value.row_code AND fr_row_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND ((fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code IN ('DN','BH') AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '300') OR (fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code = 'TD' AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '400')) INNER JOIN fr_column_template ON fr_column_template.column_code = fr_value.column_code AND fr_column_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND fr_column_template.column_description_reference = '1' -> fr_value.data_val
